Hello Alejandro,

I’m Jamie Steeg, participating as an individual, self-resourced entrant
under AutoLab owner *jimsteeg*. I need the official OpenMath submission
workflow and checker instructions before tonight’s October 2 cutoff (00:00
EDT October 3 / 21:00 PDT October 2).

(an explicitly source-conditional Kobon partial reduction), and H7 (pinned
Lean formalization lemmas; no claim to solve Erdős Problem 3). Exact
claims, provenance, exclusions, and publication authority are preserved
here:
Immutable competition packets
<https://github.com/grandchallenge/MATHSOLVE/tree/2fd9fd643bf3e9e98d121dc2e7af1cf1be411ae2/work_packages/OPENMATH_2026/COMPETITION_PACKETS>
.

Please send the competition workspace/namespace, procedure for submitting
partial results and M2 formalizations, approved checker/report route, and
any announced transfer-failure fallback. If entrant registration is
incomplete, please also identify the required step. Five existing AutoLab
jobs are staging records, not official submissions; we will preserve their
identities rather than duplicate them.

This email requests instructions and records the transfer difficulty; it
does not claim an official submission, eligibility, acceptance, or a
deadline extension. Please acknowledge receipt and direct us to the
authorized route.

Thank you,
Jamie Steeg
